# Darkville Hapsis

> Releases of Darkville Hapsis, a desktop workbench by Darkville Labs for Windows, with a terminal edition (`hapsis`) for Windows, macOS and Linux. AI agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and Grok can use the open Hapsis window through its MCP server, once the user allows it.

Start with the guide for agents: how to connect (`hapsis mcp-serve` over standard input and output, or HTTP on 127.0.0.1 with a token), the tools, and what stays with the user. Inside Hapsis's MCP server, the same guide is the `hapsis://help` resource (`hapsis_help`), in the user's language.

## Guide for agents

- [AGENTS_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/hzyrgj001/hapsis/blob/main/AGENTS_GUIDE.md): English
- [AGENTS_GUIDE.zh-Hans.md](https://github.com/hzyrgj001/hapsis/blob/main/AGENTS_GUIDE.zh-Hans.md): 简体中文
- [AGENTS_GUIDE.zh-Hant.md](https://github.com/hzyrgj001/hapsis/blob/main/AGENTS_GUIDE.zh-Hant.md): 繁體中文

## Releases

- [Latest release](https://github.com/hzyrgj001/hapsis/releases/latest): the Windows installer and the terminal edition's archives and packages
- [latest.json](https://github.com/hzyrgj001/hapsis/releases/latest/download/latest.json): the signed update file installed copies read
